agents.label: com.exos.failure-fixer-exo3
agents.schedule: every 900s (+ invoked by com.exos.fleet-status-heartbeat before it DMs)
agents.purpose: Failure→fix dispatcher (Jon 10/8: 'launch a fix and I'll just approve the fix'). Collects fleet failures from the existing detectors (fleet_status_heartbeat.cron_health/launchd_bad, completion-watchdog.scan_events), gives each a stable signature (job + error class), and launches ONE headless `openclaw agent` fix run per new signature. Safe/internal/reversible fixes are applied (verify, scoped commit, improvement-ledger entry); anything needing Jon is staged as a patch + ONE 'Approve fix: <job> — <cause>' Decision. On a human 'Approve fix' click it applies the staged patch, verifies, commits and posts the result. Heartbeat DMs show failure + fix status; applied fixes go out in one daily digest line.
agents.autonomy_tier: Execute-within-bounds (safe internal fixes) / Execute-on-approval (everything else, human-click gated)
agents.permission_envelope: READ: ~/.openclaw/state/openclaw.sqlite (ro), launchctl list, ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.exos.*.plist, logs/runs/*.jsonl, governance/events.jsonl, mission-control/data/decisions.json (read-only). WRITE: logs/failure-fixer/** (state, patches, prompts), logs/failure-fixer-exo3.log, fleet_log events; git commits limited to paths in a fix (pre-commit exo3 gate applies; never -A); improvement_ledger.py add; POST /api/decisions/ingest (one card per signature episode); one-line posts to #exomac-system via deliver.py. Spawns `openclaw agent` fix turns (<=3/hour, one per file set). Approved apply commands allow-listed: openclaw cron edit|run|enable, launchctl kickstart|bootstrap|bootout com.exos.*, /usr/bin/python3 scripts/*.py. NEVER: secrets/tokens, BOM files, decisions.json writes, migrate.js, openclaw.json protected paths, other sessions' uncommitted hunks, external email/message sends, git push. Commits touching forbidden paths are auto-reverted and escalated.
